services.name: Cybersecurity Audit
services.tagline: Know your vulnerabilities before attackers do.
services.description: A comprehensive, end-to-end security assessment of your digital infrastructure, web applications, and internal policies. We probe every layer of your stack — network, application, and human — and deliver a prioritized remediation roadmap so you know exactly what to fix and in what order.
features: Technical remediation guide with priority tiers
deliverables: 30-minute debrief call to walk through findings
ideal_for: Startups preparing for launch or funding rounds
Companies that have never had a formal security review

services.name: Custom Website
services.tagline: Built from scratch. Built to perform. Built to last.
services.description: A fully custom website designed and developed around your brand, your goals, and your users. No templates. No page builders. Clean, semantic code that performs at the top of search rankings and converts visitors into clients. Includes 12 months of support and hosting guidance.
features: Custom design aligned to your brand identity
Semantic HTML5, modern CSS, vanilla JS (no bloated frameworks)
Full source code ownership — no vendor lock-in
deliverables: Complete website deployed to your hosting
ideal_for: Service-based businesses needing a professional online presence
Freelancers and consultants replacing a dated site
Startups that need something fast, clean, and credible
Anyone tired of paying monthly fees for a Wix/Squarespace site they don't own

services.name: Security Consulting
services.tagline: An expert in your corner every month — not just once.
services.description: Ongoing security advisory and monitoring for businesses that want proactive protection rather than reactive damage control. You get a dedicated security expert available on retainer — reviewing infrastructure changes, answering team questions, training staff, and staying ahead of emerging threats.
features: Monthly security review of infrastructure changes
Incident response planning and runbook creation
Review of new third-party integrations & vendors
On-call Slack/email access (4 business hour response)
Priority pricing on additional audits or projects
deliverables: Updated threat model for your organization
Training materials and security policy templates
ideal_for: Small businesses without a dedicated security team
Companies scaling rapidly and onboarding new vendors
Organizations that have experienced past incidents
